title: Splunk product registry
description: Registry of the Splunk products a use case can be implemented in. Every consumer (structure audit, gold tier, build, generators, lift loop, ledger fingerprint) reads product behaviour from this file through splunk_uc.products; no consumer branches on a product id. See docs/adr/0017-splunk-product-per-use-case.md.

defaultProduct.description: Product assumed when a use case omits products[]. Must match one products[].id.

requires.description: Use case fields that must be present and non-empty when this product is listed first in products[].

audits.description: Audit families that apply to a use case whose primary product is this one: spl (SPL token and command checks), cim (CIM data model mapping), splReferences (sourcetype, macro, and datamodel references).

fingerprintFields.description: Fields whose content forms the identity fingerprint in data/id-ledger.json, in addition to title. A field listed here that the use case does not carry contributes an empty string.

implementSection.description: Heading of the gold-tier step that builds the detection in this product (step 2 of detailedImplementation).

artifactTypes.description: productArtifacts[].type values allowed for this product.
